title: Hobbies and Food
content: Are there any particular hobbies that you have while being in Mall World? If you do, do those hobbies happen to be extremely similar to those hobbies you have while being awake? Whenever I am in Mall World, I just spend most of my time playing arcade/ video games be it console or handheld. Sometimes I am watching TV. Also, I have noticed that whenever I eat, most foods there happen to be pasta and vegetarian (mostly rice and beans) type dishes and for dessert it's almost always filled with Chocolate. Sure there is meat, but it's usually ground meat that is used for tacos and hamburgers. I don't think I ever seen steak while being in Mall World. Sometimes I am inside a casino in which I just focus on playing poker. Anyways, the hobbies I have in Mall World just happen to match up with the hobbies that I have when I am awake.
